Container.Name: events-dashboard
Container.Overview: Personal calendar of theatre, Broadway, gallery and festival events in Sacramento and San Francisco. Scrapes venue sites and event calendars once a day, merges duplicate listings, drops sports, and serves one filterable page.
Container.Description: Personal calendar of theatre, Broadway, gallery and festival events in Sacramento and San Francisco. About 45 sources are scraped daily: event-calendar feeds where venues have them, and Claude reads the remaining venue pages. The dashboard shows a source health table so broken sources are easy to spot, and has its own sign-in for use away from home. The This week tab opens with recommended picks for the weekend, which can also come to your phone as a notification on Thursday evening. An optional MCP connector lets Claude answer questions like "what's on in SF this weekend?" from your events.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the dashboard. Without a Dashboard Password it only answers your home network. With one it has its own sign-in and can go behind a reverse proxy (an HTTP proxy host with HTTPS, on its own subdomain). Never forward this port on your router directly.

Config.Name: MCP Connector Port
Config.Description: Port for the MCP connector that lets Claude answer questions from your events (endpoint /mcp). It stays off until Connector Password or Connector Token is set. Behind a reverse proxy, give it a subdomain of its own, separate from the dashboard's.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Stores the event database, the extraction cache and the generated page. Use your appdata share.

Config.Name: Anthropic API Key
Config.Description: Used to read venue pages that have no feed, and to choose the weekly picks on the This week tab. Create one at console.anthropic.com. Without it, only feed-based and recurring sources run, and the picks are ranked by rules alone.

Config.Name: Dashboard Password
Config.Description: Turns on the dashboard's sign-in page, which is what lets you open it from outside your home network (through a reverse proxy with HTTPS, or Tailscale Serve). At least 12 characters; use a long random one (openssl rand -base64 24) and let your browser remember it. Each browser signs in once and stays signed in. Changing the password signs every browser out. Empty: the dashboard only answers your home network and refuses everything else.

Config.Name: Home Networks
Config.Description: Optional. Networks whose browsers skip the sign-in when they connect straight to the dashboard port, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24 (comma-separated; 'private' means every private range). Leave empty and, once a password is set, every browser signs in once, at home too. That is the safe default: behind a reverse proxy the dashboard can't always tell home from outside. Requests that come through a proxy always have to sign in.

Config.Name: Connector Public URL
Config.Description: The public HTTPS address of the MCP connector port, without /mcp, e.g. https://events.example.com or a Tailscale Funnel address. Needed for claude.ai, Claude Desktop and the phone app, which reach the connector from Anthropic's servers. In Claude, add this address plus /mcp as a custom connector.

Config.Name: Connector Password
Config.Description: Asked once on the sign-in page when you connect Claude. At least 12 characters; use a long random one (openssl rand -base64 24), since a public address gets found quickly. Changing it signs every connected Claude out. Don't put a reverse proxy login in front of /mcp: Claude can only sign in with this page.

Config.Name: Connector Token
Config.Description: Optional fixed bearer token for clients set up with a header, such as Claude Code on your home network or tailnet (Authorization: Bearer ...). At least 24 characters; generate one with: openssl rand -hex 24

Config.Name: Extraction Model
Config.Description: Claude model that reads venue pages without a feed. Set claude-opus-5-5 for the most accurate (and about 40 times pricier) reading.

Config.Name: Re-read Interval (days)
Config.Description: Minimum days between Claude re-reads of a venue page whose text changed. Unchanged pages are never re-read. Set 1 to re-read changed pages every day.

Config.Name: Picks Day
Config.Description: Day of the week the weekend's picks are sent as a notification to the devices that turned notifications on (This week tab, over HTTPS): mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat or sun.

Config.Name: Picks Hour
Config.Description: Hour of that day (0-23, container timezone) the notification goes out. If the container is off at that hour it is sent when it is back, up to 18 hours later.

Config.Name: Picks Model
Config.Description: Claude model that chooses the weekly picks from the shortlist and writes why. About one call a day, roughly 20 to 30 cents each with claude-opus-5-5; claude-haiku-5-5 costs under a cent and chooses less well.

Config.Name: Scrape Hour
Config.Description: Hour of the day (0-23, container timezone) for the daily scrape. A scrape also runs when the container starts.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone. Sets when the daily scrape runs, when the weekly notification goes out and how dates are shown.
